title: Personal Weather Forecast
description: What's the weather going to be? NWS forecast dashboard showing temperature, wind, humidity, dewpoint, cloud cover, and pressure.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current Temperature from latest forecast
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (temperature_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE temperature_c
    END AS "Air Temp",
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN heat_index_c IS NOT NULL AND heat_index_c > temperature_c + 2 THEN heat_index_c
                    WHEN wind_chill_c IS NOT NULL AND wind_chill_c < temperature_c - 2 THEN wind_chill_c
                    ELSE apparent_temperature_c
                END,
                temperature_c
            ) * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE COALESCE(
            CASE
                WHEN heat_index_c IS NOT NULL AND heat_index_c > temperature_c + 2 THEN heat_index_c
                WHEN wind_chill_c IS NOT NULL AND wind_chill_c < temperature_c - 2 THEN wind_chill_c
                ELSE apparent_temperature_c
            END,
            temperature_c
        )
    END AS "Feels Like"
FROM silver.weather_forecasts
WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
  AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
  AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY valid_time ASC, issue_time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Wind speed and direction with gust

targets.rawSql:
-- Current Wind from latest forecast
SELECT
    CASE '${wind_unit}'
        WHEN 'mph' THEN ROUND(wind_speed_kmh * 0.621371)
        WHEN 'ms' THEN ROUND(wind_speed_kmh / 3.6, 1)
        ELSE ROUND(wind_speed_kmh)
    END AS "Speed",
    CASE
        WHEN wind_direction_deg IS NULL THEN 'VAR'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg >= 337.5 OR wind_direction_deg < 22.5 THEN 'N'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 67.5 THEN 'NE'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 112.5 THEN 'E'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 157.5 THEN 'SE'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 202.5 THEN 'S'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 247.5 THEN 'SW'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 292.5 THEN 'W'
        ELSE 'NW'
    END AS "Direction",
    CASE '${wind_unit}'
        WHEN 'mph' THEN ROUND(COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) * 0.621371)
        WHEN 'ms' THEN ROUND(COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) / 3.6, 1)
        ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh))
    END AS "Gust"
FROM silver.weather_forecasts
WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
  AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
  AND wind_speed_kmh IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY valid_time ASC, issue_time DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Current Humidity from latest forecast
SELECT humidity_pct AS value
FROM silver.weather_forecasts
WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
  AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
  AND humidity_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY valid_time ASC, issue_time DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Current Dewpoint from latest forecast
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (dewpoint_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE dewpoint_c
    END AS value
FROM silver.weather_forecasts
WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
  AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
  AND dewpoint_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY valid_time ASC, issue_time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Cloud Cover
panels.description: Sky condition from forecast. Falls back to short_forecast text if % unavailable.

targets.rawSql:
-- Cloud Cover from latest forecast
SELECT
    COALESCE(sky_cover_pct, 0)::INTEGER AS "Cover %",
    CASE
        WHEN sky_cover_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 6 THEN 'Clear'
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 25 THEN 'Mostly Clear'
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 50 THEN 'Partly Cloudy'
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 87 THEN 'Mostly Cloudy'
                ELSE 'Cloudy'
            END
        ELSE COALESCE(short_forecast, 'N/A')
    END AS "Condition"
FROM silver.weather_forecasts
WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
  AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
ORDER BY valid_time ASC, issue_time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Current observed barometric pressure with 3-hour trend

targets.rawSql:
-- Current Pressure from Observations with trend
WITH current_obs AS (
    SELECT observation_time, pressure_pa
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE pressure_pa IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
past_obs AS (
    SELECT pressure_pa
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time <= (SELECT observation_time FROM current_obs) - INTERVAL '3 hours'
      AND observation_time >= (SELECT observation_time FROM current_obs) - INTERVAL '3.5 hours'
      AND pressure_pa IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    CASE '${pressure_unit}'
        WHEN 'inHg' THEN ROUND((c.pressure_pa / 100.0) * 0.02953, 2)
        ELSE ROUND(c.pressure_pa / 100.0, 1)
    END AS "Pressure",
    CASE
        WHEN p.pressure_pa IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa > 200 THEN 'Rising Fast'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa > 50 THEN 'Rising'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa < -200 THEN 'Falling Fast'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa < -50 THEN 'Falling'
        ELSE 'Steady'
    END AS "Trend"
FROM current_obs c
LEFT JOIN past_obs p ON true

panels.title: Rain Chance
panels.description: Max precipitation probability in next 6 hours

targets.rawSql:
-- Rain Chance: Max in next 6 hours
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(precip_prob_pct), 0)::INTEGER AS value
FROM silver.weather_forecasts
WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
  AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '6 hours'

panels.title: Temperature Forecast
panels.description: Forecast temperature over next 48 hours with feels-like overlay

targets.rawSql:
-- Temperature Forecast Timeline (48 hours)
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        temperature_c,
        COALESCE(
            CASE
                WHEN heat_index_c IS NOT NULL AND heat_index_c > temperature_c + 2 THEN heat_index_c
                WHEN wind_chill_c IS NOT NULL AND wind_chill_c < temperature_c - 2 THEN wind_chill_c
                ELSE apparent_temperature_c
            END,
            temperature_c
        ) AS feels_like_c,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY valid_time ORDER BY issue_time DESC) AS rn
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
      AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    valid_time AS time,
    CASE WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (temperature_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32 ELSE temperature_c END AS "Temperature",
    CASE WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (feels_like_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32 ELSE feels_like_c END AS "Feels Like"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY valid_time

panels.title: Wind & Gusts Forecast
panels.description: Wind speed and gust forecast over next 48 hours

targets.rawSql:
-- Wind Speed Forecast (48 hours)
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        wind_speed_kmh,
        wind_gust_kmh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY valid_time ORDER BY issue_time DESC) AS rn
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
      AND wind_speed_kmh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    valid_time AS time,
    CASE '${wind_unit}' WHEN 'mph' THEN wind_speed_kmh * 0.621371 WHEN 'ms' THEN wind_speed_kmh / 3.6 ELSE wind_speed_kmh END AS "Wind Speed",
    CASE '${wind_unit}' WHEN 'mph' THEN COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) * 0.621371 WHEN 'ms' THEN COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) / 3.6 ELSE COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) END AS "Gusts"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY valid_time

panels.title: Precipitation & Cloud Cover
panels.description: Chance of rain and cloud cover over next 48 hours

targets.rawSql:
-- Precipitation and Cloud Cover (48 hours)
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        precip_prob_pct,
        sky_cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY valid_time ORDER BY issue_time DESC) AS rn
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
)
SELECT
    valid_time AS time,
    COALESCE(precip_prob_pct, 0) AS "Rain Chance %",
    sky_cover_pct AS "Cloud Cover %"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY valid_time

panels.title: Humidity & Dewpoint Forecast
panels.description: Humidity and dewpoint trends for comfort assessment

targets.rawSql:
-- Humidity and Dewpoint Forecast (48 hours)
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        humidity_pct,
        dewpoint_c,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY valid_time ORDER BY issue_time DESC) AS rn
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
)
SELECT
    valid_time AS time,
    humidity_pct AS "Humidity %",
    CASE WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (dewpoint_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32 ELSE dewpoint_c END AS "Dewpoint"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND (humidity_pct IS NOT NULL OR dewpoint_c IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY valid_time

-- Pressure from Observations
SELECT
    time_bucket('30 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    CASE '${pressure_unit}' WHEN 'inHg' THEN AVG(pressure_pa / 100.0) * 0.02953 ELSE AVG(pressure_pa / 100.0) END AS "Pressure"
FROM silver.weather_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= NOW()
  AND pressure_pa IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 7-Day Forecast Summary
panels.description: Daily high/low, wind, humidity, rain chance for the next 7 days

targets.rawSql:
-- 7-Day Forecast Summary Table
WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(valid_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS forecast_date,
        MAX(COALESCE(max_temperature_c, temperature_c)) AS max_temp,
        MIN(COALESCE(min_temperature_c, temperature_c)) AS min_temp,
        AVG(wind_speed_kmh) AS avg_wind,
        AVG(humidity_pct) AS avg_humidity,
        MAX(precip_prob_pct) AS max_precip,
        AVG(sky_cover_pct) AS avg_sky_cover,
        MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY short_forecast) AS short_forecast
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(forecast_date, 'Dy, Mon DD') AS "Day",
    CASE WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN ROUND(max_temp * 9.0/5.0 + 32)::TEXT || ' F' ELSE ROUND(max_temp)::TEXT || ' C' END AS "High",
    CASE WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN ROUND(min_temp * 9.0/5.0 + 32)::TEXT || ' F' ELSE ROUND(min_temp)::TEXT || ' C' END AS "Low",
    CASE '${wind_unit}' WHEN 'mph' THEN ROUND(avg_wind * 0.621371)::TEXT || ' mph' WHEN 'ms' THEN ROUND(avg_wind / 3.6, 1)::TEXT || ' m/s' ELSE ROUND(avg_wind)::TEXT || ' km/h' END AS "Wind",
    ROUND(avg_humidity)::TEXT || '%' AS "Humidity",
    ROUND(COALESCE(max_precip, 0))::TEXT || '%' AS "Rain",
    CASE
        WHEN avg_sky_cover IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE WHEN avg_sky_cover <= 25 THEN 'Sunny' WHEN avg_sky_cover <= 50 THEN 'Partly Cloudy' WHEN avg_sky_cover <= 75 THEN 'Mostly Cloudy' ELSE 'Cloudy' END
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END AS "Sky",
    COALESCE(short_forecast, '') AS "Forecast"
FROM daily
ORDER BY forecast_date
LIMIT 7
